inviteText:
Subject: Discovery call - Allstate - IT operations, vendor risk and asset visibility on ServiceNow
Date: Thursday, December 10, 2026, 11:00-11:30 AM CT
Organizer: Royal Cyber presales team
Company: Allstate (allstate.com)

Attendees:
- Rowan Achterberg, VP, IT Service Management, rowan.achterberg@allstate.com
- Tomas Whitlock-Abara, Chief Information Officer, tomas.whitlock-abara@allstate.com
- Ulrike Papadakis, Manager, Vendor Risk and Compliance, ulrike.papadakis@allstate.com

Notes: Warm introduction from a partner. They want faster incident resolution across IT operations, better visibility of IT assets, and a cleaner process for assessing third-party vendors. Ask which ServiceNow modules they already run and who owns the budget.

facts.text: The Allstate Corporation is an American insurance company.
Allstate is headquartered in Glenview, Illinois since 2022.
Allstate was founded on April 17, 1931 as part of Sears, Roebuck and Co.
Allstate was spun off from Sears in 1993 but remained partially owned by Sears until becoming completely independent in June 1995.
Allstate has personal line insurance operations in Canada.
Allstate's headquarters address is listed as Northbrook, Illinois, U.S.
Thomas J. Wilson is Allstate's chairman, president, and CEO.
Allstate offers Auto, Home, Life, Motorcycle, Renters, Boat, Landlord, Condo, Off-road vehicle, and Business Insurance products.
Allstate offers Retirement & Investment products and Banking services.
Allstate's revenue was US$64.11 billion in 2024.
Allstate's operating income was US$5.76 billion in 2024.
Allstate's net income was US$4.67 million in 2024.
Allstate has approximately 55,000 employees as of 2024.
Allstate's total assets were US$111.6 billion in 2024.
Allstate's total equity was US$21.44 billion in 2024.
Allstate is a publicly traded company on NYSE under ticker ALL and is an S&P 500 component.
Allstate's subsidiaries include Encompass Insurance Company, Esurance, SquareTrade, Allstate Identity Protection, Allstate India, Allstate Northern Ireland, and National General Insurance.
Allstate's advertising campaign 'Are you in good hands?' has been in use since 1950.
Allstate Insurance Company was named after Sears' tire line and began offering auto insurance by direct mail on April 17, 1931.
Allstate faces concerns from shops regarding ADAS calibration pricing practices.

painPointHypotheses.text: With 55,000 employees across multiple subsidiaries and geographic markets, Allstate likely experiences operational complexity and integration challenges in managing IT operations and asset visibility across diverse business units.

Managing vendor relationships and third-party risk assessment across a large enterprise with multiple insurance products and international operations requires streamlined processes and cleaner governance.
Recent industry scrutiny around pricing practices and claims handling suggests Allstate may need improved operational transparency and faster incident resolution capabilities across IT operations.

agenda.note: Brief overview of Royal Cyber and ServiceNow capabilities. Confirm attendees and their roles.

agenda.topic: Current IT operations and incident resolution
agenda.note: Understand existing ServiceNow modules in use, current incident resolution timelines, and pain points with speed and visibility.

agenda.topic: Asset visibility and IT asset management needs
agenda.note: Explore challenges with IT asset tracking across multiple business units and subsidiaries. Discuss current tooling and gaps.

agenda.topic: Vendor risk management and third-party assessment
agenda.note: Discuss current vendor assessment processes, governance challenges, and need for cleaner, more automated workflows.
Identify budget owner and key stakeholders for potential ServiceNow expansion or optimization.

agenda.topic: Next steps and case study review
agenda.note: Share relevant case studies on ITOM, ITAM, and GRC. Schedule follow-up conversations with appropriate stakeholders.

discoveryQuestions.text: Which ServiceNow modules does Allstate currently have deployed, and how are they being utilized across your IT operations?
What is your current average incident resolution time, and what are the primary bottlenecks preventing faster resolution?
How do you currently track and maintain visibility of IT assets across your 55,000 employees and multiple subsidiaries?
What challenges do you face when assessing third-party vendor risk, and how is that process currently managed?
Who owns the budget for IT operations tools and ServiceNow platform investments, and what is the approval process?
How are IT operations and asset management currently integrated or siloed across your different business units and geographic locations?
What metrics or KPIs are most important to your leadership for measuring IT operations effectiveness?
Are there specific compliance or governance requirements that impact how you manage vendor assessments and IT asset visibility?
What would success look like for you in terms of faster incident resolution, better asset visibility, and vendor risk management?
Beyond these three areas, are there other IT operational challenges where you see ServiceNow as a potential solution?
